quarterly_data.quarter: Dai Nippon Printing semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-14-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half (April-September 2025) of the fiscal year ending March 2026 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 738,701 million (+4.3% YoY from JPY 708,352 million), operating profit JPY 46,648 million (+22.2%), ordinary profit JPY 52,910 million (+5.8%); net profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 60,358 million (-32.7%), which included extraordinary gains on sales of investment securities. Segment sales / segment profit: Smart Communication JPY 357,988 million (+3.3%) / JPY 14,768 million (+16.9%), helped by business restructuring and higher sales of photo-print materials; Life & Healthcare JPY 258,315 million (+6.3%) / JPY 18,149 million (+100.4%) on cost reductions and restructuring - battery pouches for IT devices grew on strong demand for new smartphone and tablet models, and automotive pouches rose YoY on the market recovery since October 2024 and battery makers' new plants, although battery-maker customers restrained orders after the US decided to end EV subsidies; Electronics JPY 123,781 million (+3.4%) / JPY 26,682 million (-4.2%). Group R&D expense JPY 20,294 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 738,701 million (+4.3%); operating profit JPY 46,648 million (+22.2%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Dai Nippon Printing semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-14-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronics, first half to September 2025 (semi-annual report): semiconductor-related sales were roughly flat YoY in a firm market, while DNP worked on expanding into cutting-edge areas such as EUV (extreme ultraviolet) masks and nanoimprint. Digital Interface rose YoY - OLED metal masks grew on wider OLED adoption in smartphones and display optical films were firm on larger LCD TV panels. Segment profit fell 4.2% to JPY 26,682 million because of foreign exchange and the strategic investment in the semiconductor business, although Digital Interface profit grew with the expansion of that focus business. The planned completion of the new Digital Interface manufacturing facility at Kurosaki Plant was changed from March 2027 to January 2028.
quarterly_data.figure: Electronics H1 segment profit JPY 26,682 million (-4.2%); Kurosaki facility completion moved from March 2027 to January 2028
